error_handling.overview: Error scenarios, recovery procedures, and graceful failure handling for autonomous research experiments.

scenario.name: oom_crash
scenario.description: Out of memory error during training
scenario.symptoms: - CUDA out of memory error in run.log - peak_vram_mb exceeds available GPU memory

recovery.step: Reduce model size or batch size for next experiment

scenario.prevention: - Check current peak_vram_mb before proposing memory-intensive changes - For small GPUs, reduce n_embd or n_layer instead of increasing them

scenario.name: nan_loss
scenario.symptoms: - val_bpb shows NaN or inf in output - Training loss becomes NaN during training

recovery.step: Reduce learning rate for next experiment

scenario.prevention: - Start with conservative learning rates - Ensure gradient clipping is enabled

scenario.name: timeout
scenario.symptoms: - Process killed after 10 minutes - No complete results in run.log

recovery.step: Reduce batch size or model size for faster training

scenario.prevention: - Keep TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE at powers of 2 - Monitor training_seconds in previous runs

scenario.name: git_conflict
scenario.description: Git state is dirty or has uncommitted changes
scenario.symptoms: - git commit fails with uncommitted changes - Branch has unexpected commits

recovery.step: Check git status to understand state
git stash or git reset as appropriate

scenario.prevention: - Always reset after each experiment (keep or discard) - Never manually commit outside the research loop

scenario.name: dependency_error
scenario.symptoms: - uv run fails with import errors - Package version conflicts

recovery.step: Run uv sync to reinstall dependencies

scenario.prevention: - Verify dependencies in initialization step - Use uv for reproducible environments

case.action: Pause research, analyze failure pattern, suggest configuration changes
Suggest exploring new research directions or changing hypothesis strategy
Save current state, document progress, resume when hardware is available

logging_requirements.rule: Always log crashes with val_bpb: 0.000000 and memory_gb: 0.0
Include descriptive status in results.tsv for debugging
Preserve run.log files for post-mortem analysis
